decisions.reason: The product is close to the firm's established offer and the firm has in-house R&D, so it can interpret early results and improve the app.
Although a continuing education institute is a new format, it builds on the firm's established offer and practitioner knowledge, and in-house R&D supports learning, so the firm is likely to keep it.
The remote screen sharing support tool builds on the firm's established software and support capabilities, and the firm's R&D enables it to interpret and improve the tool.
